text:
deploy-bot: Release candidate rc-2026-03-20 blocked: model variant mismatch detected between staging and prod for model 'redwood-7b'. Prod catalog missing variant 'v2-quant'. Action: manual intervention required to backfill or revert.

sara: Huh, we explicitly pinned canary to v2-quant in the release manifest. Did we change naming conventions? :thinking_face:

mike: Checking registry. Staging shows variants: [v1, v2-quant]. Prod shows [v1]. Could be an import/job failure or case-sensitive name.

raj: I noticed the model-registry job errored last night against prod during the variant import. Logs show HTTP 429 from registry-api around 03:12 UTC. I'll try a backfill.

sara: If backfill is messy, can we revert the pin in the helm values to redwood-7b:v1 as a quick fallback? We have a 2h release window.

mike: I prefer to pin the k8s manifest to v1 for immediate safety. I'll open a rollback PR that pins the model image/variant in helm values. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3456 — set chart.values.model.variant = v1.

raj: Starting backfill now. Command: `scripts/backfill_model_variant.sh --model redwood-7b --variant v2-quant --env prod` — this will call model-registry with retry logic. ETA ~ 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: If the registry keeps rate-limiting, we can also POST the variant directly (manual) — example (omitting token):
```
curl -X POST "https://model-registry.internal/api/models/redwood-7b/variants" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"v2-quant","storage_path":"s3://redwood-models/redwood-7b/v2-quant"}'
```
But prefer job + retries for auditability.

mike: I'll hold the PR open until we know backfill status. If backfill fails, we'll merge PR and continue with v1 fallback.

raj: Backfill job logs: `2026-03-20T04:10:12Z RETRY attempt=3 status=429`, then `2026-03-20T04:17:51Z POST /variants 201 Created`.

raj: Verified registry now lists v2-quant for prod. Quick verification: `curl -sS https://model-registry.internal/api/models/redwood-7b | jq .variants` -> ["v1","v2-quant"]

sara: Nice. Can we also validate the model store path exists on s3 and that serving infra can pull it?

raj: Ran a smoke pull on canary node: `dlopen s3://redwood-models/redwood-7b/v2-quant/model.bin` -> OK.

deploy-bot: Release unblocked. Proceeding with canary deploy to prod (canary window 30m). Action log: variant-backfill succeeded, no further manual actions. :white_check_mark:

mike: I'll cancel the rollback PR since backfill succeeded. Will keep an eye on post-deploy metrics.

sara: Thanks all. Follow-up: add alert for failed model-registry imports to avoid silent misses. Filed issue: https://git.redwood/repo/issues/789

deploy-bot: Note: release window closes in 2h. If any degradation, automatic rollback policy will pin to redwood-7b:v1.
